facts.text: I am looking for inspiration for my next painting project.
I have been experimenting with different painting techniques lately.
I am open to new ideas for my painting project.
I have completed three painting pieces in the past few months.
I like mixed media and abstract expressionism.
I want to incorporate fabric into my paintings.
I am thinking about hosting a painting party at my place.
I want finger foods and drinks that are easy to eat and not messy for the painting party.
I am thinking of having inspirational art books or prints around to spark creativity at the party.
I am thinking of setting up a few painting stations with different materials and techniques, like pouring paint or using sponges.
I want suggestions for other materials or techniques to include at the painting stations.
